parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic. It is small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that dispenses liquid when pressed, controlling the flow of soap or lotion through the pump mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head is the middle section connecting the pressing lid to the base body, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the pump mechanism and connects the lid to the suction tube inside the bottle, ensuring proper liquid transfer.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but allows internal pump components to move during operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent or semi-transparent PET plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid (soap, lotion, sanitizer, etc.) and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
